description: This file defines the Prospect class, a model representing prospects in the SuiteCRM system. It extends a Person class, implements EmailInterface, and includes methods for building search queries, converting prospects, retrieving related targets, and managing email associations.

classes.name: Prospect
classes.description: A class representing a prospect entity in SuiteCRM, with properties for personal and contact information, and methods for search, conversion, retrieval, and email management.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Populates additional list view fields, including proper name formatting and email display.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional detail view fields, including proper name formatting.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Constructs a dynamic SQL WHERE clause for searching prospects based on a query string.

methods.name: converted_prospect
methods.description: Updates the prospect record to mark it as converted, linking it to contact, account, and opportunity IDs.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean implements a specific interface, e.g., ACL.

methods.name: retrieveTargetList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of target prospects based on a query, supporting joins and field selection.

methods.name: retrieveTarget
methods.description: Retrieves a related entity (e.g., contact, account) based on a prospect list relation ID.

methods.name: get_unlinked_email_query
methods.description: Generates a query for unlinked emails related to the prospect.
